name: Jordan Rivera
headline: Staff Software Engineer | Backend | Event-Driven Systems

summary.text: Backend engineer who traces performance problems to their root and sets integration standards other teams adopt. Works in TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS messaging.

items.label: Standards
items.text: wrote the event schema and versioning standard adopted by three teams

bullets.text: Cut order-history API p95 latency from 1.2s to 300ms by moving filtering into **PostgreSQL window functions** and adding targeted indexes
Led the event schema, versioning, and dead-letter standard for three teams' SNS/SQS integrations
Built an event-driven proof of concept to replace a vendor scanning flow, validated on real handheld scanners
